title: CodebookGeneratedEvent
description: Carried on codebook.generated. Summary only; full signatures fetched via the Codebook Generator API.

snapshotId.description: Topology snapshot this codebook was compiled from.

domain.description: the domain this snapshot/event belongs to (e.g. `core-ip`); a snapshot belongs to exactly one domain. Optional for backward-compat; consumers default to the single MVP domain when absent.

scenarioCount.description: Number of scenarios in this codebook.

codebookId.description: Identifies this codebook version; referenced as matchedCodebookId in CorrelationResultEvent.
